D3.title: Private drafts: how do the two files reach the folder?
D3.lead: PQRT wrote two private draft files, but its Drive tool cannot upload them: it needs a file reference that PQRT cannot make from its local files. Nothing is saved yet (0 of 2).

options.label: A
options.body: You save the two files by hand. It takes about a minute.
steps: You reply with the text below. This also approves showing the files in PQRT's own private chat, which is an exception to "Drive folder only".
OTM asks PQRT to attach the two ZIPs in its chat.
You download both and drag them into the Drive folder `Local Agent Handoffs` (My Drive). Keep the file names exactly. Do not open, edit or share them.
OTM attaches both files from Drive to PQRT. PQRT recomputes size and SHA-256, which must match the table above.
Only then does OTM attach them to the checker PCHK, which recomputes the hashes again before it reviews.
options.reply: Drive: Route A. PQRT may show phy-nlm-010-option-diagnosis-a1.zip and phy-nlm-022-diagnosis-only-a1.zip in its own chat, and I will save them into Local Agent Handoffs myself.
options.short: Drive: Route A, I will save phy-nlm-010-option-diagnosis-a1.zip and phy-nlm-022-diagnosis-only-a1.zip into Local Agent Handoffs myself.

options.label: B
options.body: Wait for a connector that accepts raw file content. Nobody has found one that does, so this has no date.
options.reply: Drive: Route B. Wait for a connector that takes raw file content; do not use any other route.
options.short: Drive: Route B, wait for a connector that takes raw file content.

options.label: C
options.body: Stay blocked until you give another way to move the files.
options.reply: Drive: Route C. Stay blocked. I will give you another way to move the files.
